ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels in upper lobe regions versus 60% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels in central and edge regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the upper 50% of both fluke lobes. A central, low-intensity black region radiates from the notch area. Tan-colored mottling is visible within the white pixel clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a measured pixel-based interior angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing edge boundary; characterized by irregular peaks and valleys with amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upper edges exhibit a convex curve tapering to acute, irregular lateral tips; trailing edges follow a complex concave-to-convex trajectory toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-contrast white and brown pixel groups located at the distal tips of both lobes, identifying macro-organism attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous high-contrast, unaligned white linear marks (rake marks) ranging from 10 to 150 pixels in length, primarily visible against the low-intensity dark central background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) across the lower ventral surface; heavy calcified clusters on both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-tan pixel staining overlaying the white pigmentation zones on the upper lobe surfaces.
